title: Call UCSF Medical Center billing for you?

asks: Ask for the free care under their own policy, bringing the bill to $0
Ask them to pause collections while it's reviewed, and get a case number
detail.say: I won't agree to pay anything on the call. Any payment comes back to you first.

speaker: rep
text: Patient Financial Services, this is Diane.

speaker: billback
text: Hello Diane, I'm BillBack, an automated assistant calling on behalf of patient Marcus Lee with his authorization. This call is transcribed. His account number is UCSF-30772154. I'm calling about a financial assistance review for a July 19, 2026 service date.

speaker: rep
text: I show the full balance due on that account.

speaker: billback
text: Understood. The EOB shows the patient responsibility is $5,600, which matches what your system shows, but Mr. Lee qualifies for free care under UCSF's own policy. His income is about 174% of the Federal Poverty Level, under the 400% limit, and his out-of-pocket costs exceed 10% of income. Can you open a financial assistance review?

speaker: rep
text: Hmm, I don't see a payment. What date was it?

speaker: billback
text: There was no payment made on this account, so there's nothing to apply. The full $5,600 is still the balance, and that's exactly why we're requesting the assistance review. Can you open that review for him?

speaker: rep
text: Okay. Can you pay the balance by card today?

speaker: billback
text: I can't provide or agree to any payment, and Mr. Lee will review any payment arrangement himself. I'll follow up on that separately. For now, can you open the financial assistance review under the hospital's policy?

speaker: rep
text: Fine. I'll open a financial assistance review and put a hold on the account. Your case number is FA 20931.

speaker: billback
text: Thank you. Let me confirm the case number: FA 20931. Could you also confirm your full name and that the account is on hold so it won't go to collections while the review is pending?
